results.title: What it costs to keep an agent running
results.author: A. Writer
highlights:
Most of the cost of an idle agent is the first request of every wake:
 the system prompt and tool definitions are sent again.
Prompt caching cuts that by roughly 90% when wakes are less than five minutes apart.

results.title: Search APIs for LLM agents compared
highlights: Per-request pricing ranges from $4 to $15 per thousand searches, depending on depth.
